account_snapshots_source.name: account_snapshots_source
account_snapshots_source.value: ("account_snapshots"."source" = 'plaid' and "account_snapshots"."account_id" is not null) or ("account_snapshots"."source" = 'manual' and "account_snapshots"."manual_account_id" is not null)

assets_text_lengths.name: assets_text_lengths
assets_text_lengths.value:
char_length("assets"."make") <= 120
        and char_length("assets"."model") <= 120
        and char_length("assets"."serial_number") <= 120
        and char_length("assets"."location") <= 120
        and char_length("assets"."notes") <= 4000

bills_due_month.name: bills_due_month
bills_due_month.value:
("bills"."cadence" = 'monthly' and "bills"."due_month" is null)
        or ("bills"."cadence" <> 'monthly' and "bills"."due_month" between 1 and 12)

bookings_text_lengths.name: bookings_text_lengths
bookings_text_lengths.value:
char_length("bookings"."confirmation_code") <= 40
        and char_length("bookings"."provider_name") <= 80
        and char_length("bookings"."property_name") <= 120
        and char_length("bookings"."origin") <= 80
        and char_length("bookings"."destination") <= 80

bookings_flight_shape.name: bookings_flight_shape
bookings_flight_shape.value:
"bookings"."kind" <> 'flight' or (
        "bookings"."carrier" is not null and "bookings"."cabin" is not null
        and "bookings"."origin" is not null and "bookings"."destination" is not null
        and "bookings"."depart_at" is not null and "bookings"."rate_plan" is null
        and "bookings"."check_in" is null and "bookings"."check_out" is null
      )

bookings_stay_shape.name: bookings_stay_shape
bookings_stay_shape.value:
"bookings"."kind" = 'flight' or (
        "bookings"."rate_plan" is not null and "bookings"."check_in" is not null
        and "bookings"."check_out" is not null and "bookings"."depart_at" is null
        and "bookings"."return_at" is null and "bookings"."carrier" is null and "bookings"."cabin" is null
        and "bookings"."refundable" = ("bookings"."rate_plan" = 'refundable')
      )

budgets_closed_snapshot.name: budgets_closed_snapshot
budgets_closed_snapshot.value:
("budgets"."closed_at" is null) = ("budgets"."unbudgeted_cents" is null)
        and ("budgets"."closed_at" is null) = ("budgets"."uncategorized_cents" is null)

contacts_text_lengths.name: contacts_text_lengths
contacts_text_lengths.value:
char_length("contacts"."role") <= 80
        and char_length("contacts"."phone") <= 40
        and char_length("contacts"."email") <= 254
        and char_length("contacts"."url") <= 2000
        and char_length("contacts"."notes") <= 4000

events_all_day_whole_days.name: events_all_day_whole_days
events_all_day_whole_days.value:
not "events"."all_day" or (
        "events"."ends_at" > "events"."starts_at"
        and ("events"."starts_at" at time zone 'UTC')::time = '00:00'
        and ("events"."ends_at" at time zone 'UTC')::time = '00:00'
      )

events_external_shape.name: events_external_shape
events_external_shape.value:
(
        "events"."external_source" is null and "events"."external_id" is null
        and "events"."external_calendar_id" is null and "events"."calendar_link_id" is null
        and "events"."last_synced_at" is null
      ) or (
        "events"."external_source" is not null and "events"."external_id" is not null
        and "events"."external_calendar_id" is not null and "events"."calendar_link_id" is not null
        and "events"."last_synced_at" is not null and "events"."rrule" is null
      )

itinerary_options_hours.name: itinerary_options_hours
itinerary_options_hours.value:
("itinerary_options"."opens_at" is null) = ("itinerary_options"."closes_at" is null)
        and "itinerary_options"."opens_at" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$' and "itinerary_options"."closes_at" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$'

price_checks_outcome.name: price_checks_outcome
price_checks_outcome.value:
("price_checks"."success" and "price_checks"."price_cents" > 0 and "price_checks"."error" is null)
        or (not "price_checks"."success" and "price_checks"."price_cents" is null and "price_checks"."error" is not null)

renewals_text_lengths.name: renewals_text_lengths
renewals_text_lengths.value:
char_length("renewals"."provider") <= 200
        and char_length("renewals"."reference_number") <= 200
        and char_length("renewals"."url") <= 2000
        and char_length("renewals"."notes") <= 4000

transactions_category_has_source.name: transactions_category_has_source
transactions_category_has_source.value: "transactions"."category_id" is null or "transactions"."category_source" is not null

trip_guests_source_shape.name: trip_guests_source_shape
trip_guests_source_shape.value: case when "trip_guests"."source" = 'email' then "trip_guests"."token_hash" is not null else "trip_guests"."token_hash" is null and "trip_guests"."user_id" is not null end

trips_dates_valid.name: trips_dates_valid
trips_dates_valid.value: ("trips"."starts_on" is null) = ("trips"."ends_on" is null) and ("trips"."ends_on" is null or "trips"."ends_on" >= "trips"."starts_on")
